author: agent
objective: Association of 2018 annual PM10 daily-limit exceedance days with cumulative COVID-19 infections among Italian provincial-capital cities, adjusted for 2019 population density.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Association of 2018 annual PM10 daily-limit exceedance days with cumulative COVID-19 infections among Italian provincial-capital cities, adjusted for 2019 population density.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Cumulative confirmed COVID-19 infections among residents of randomly selected Italian provincial-capital cities (N=55), separately at 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Outcome ratio for a doubling of annual 2018 PM10 daily-limit exceedance days, exp(beta*ln(2)) from log-log OLS.
principal_variants: Adjusted log-log OLS for infections at 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020, each with log 2019 population density.
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: Italian provincial-capital cities; article reports random selection of 55.

article_evidence.finding: Data/design and Table 6 specify N=55 provincial capitals, 2018 PM10/ozone exceedance days, March/April 2020 infection outcomes, 2019 density, and log-log OLS.
Task primary construct is PM10 >50 µg/m³ annual exceedance count and doubling contrast.

article_evidence_map.ambiguity: Article's methods largely say PM10 or ozone, whereas Table 6 says PM10. Primary analysis follows task PM10 construct; combined measure is sensitivity if recoverable.

execution_design.geographic_representation: Provincial-capital coordinates supplied in the DPC provincial archive; fixed city-reference-point support, not personal exposure or population-weighted area concentration.
execution_design.assignment_method: Nearest available PM10 monitor within 100 km; one monitor per city after national catalog discovery.
execution_design.source_strategy: OpenAQ v3 discovery and public S3 historical archive fallback, with regulator/EEA recovery if insufficient.
execution_design.exposure_metric: Annual 2018 count of observed daily mean PM10 values strictly >50 µg/m³.
execution_design.daily_aggregation: Daily PM10 series supplied/retrieved at daily resolution; retain observation-level provenance and coverage.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Per-city count of threshold-exceedance days from 2018, joined to the 55-unit outcome/density table.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report observed daily coverage and distances; no precommitted numeric exclusion threshold. Fit deterministic complete-case feasible subset only if variation and coverage support it.
execution_design.intended_use: Exposure covariate in locked log-log OLS COVID-19 city analysis.

evidence.finding: 55 fixed city-reference coordinates and the complete 2018 window loaded into AERIS.
AERIS catalog plan estimates 65 bounded calls and a public historical archive fallback.
Article specifies annual days exceeding PM10 limits, city-level analysis.

amendments.scientific_justification: This operationalizes the locked PM10 target using a transparent city-monitor assignment; it does not alter outcome, pollutant, period, contrast, or model family.
